messages.subject: [Basta-users] memory useage and categorical covariates
messages.body_plain:
Hi Caroline,

Thanks for reporting the error. We will check why the error is still 
occuring and get back to you as soon as we know.

Best wishes,
Maren
(also part of the BaSTA-team)



Am 28.08.2014 17:21, schrieb caroline chong:
> Hi Fernando,
>
> I have just downloaded and tried the first model on my list that has a 
> single categorical covariate, corresponding to three different groups 
> (populations).
>
> Following "no errors were detected with the data" I get reported:
> Error in FUN(newX[, i], ...) : invalid 'type' (character) of argument.
>
> Following is the code, specifying a Gompertz model and fused covariate 
> structure, and part of my input data matrix - but just let me know if 
> the entire data set would be helpful in deciphering the problem and I 
> will send that through. Many thanks for your suggestions with this.
>
> Meanwhile, we can report that the thinning appears to be working as 
> our larger model is running smoothly at the moment - I'll keep you 
> updated as/if it runs to completion!
>
> Thanks and
> best regards,
> Caroline

great, thanks maren! We appreciate your help and look forward to your response.
